title: Scorching Kiln -- Cobblemon Addon
description: This addon adds Scorching Kiln, a past paradox Fakemon of Claydol.
body:
To install this addon, make sure to add it to both the **Data Pack** folder for a world as well as the **Resource Pack** folder. If it is not added to the Resource Pack folder, the textures will fail to load!

Cobblemon is required to run this, and can be found by just searching Cobblemon on modrinth. Any version will work!

As of right now, this Pokemon only spawns in the Ultra Rare spawn pool over lava underground in the overworld, but I'm working on adding a custom structure where it can be found more reliably!

To Do:
- Additional animations.
- Animated lava texture.
- Custom structure for more reliable spawning.

Also, I suppose it goes without saying, but please don't use the design in other projects without asking first.
